content: ग्रन्थिः .²1 A knot, bunch, protuberance in general; स्तनौ मांसग्रन्थी कनककलशावित्युपमितौ <ls>Bh. 3. 20</ls>; so मेदोग्रन्थि. .²2 A tie or knot of a cord, garment <ab>&c.</ab>; इदमुपहितसूक्ष्मग्रन्थिना स्कन्धदेशे <ls>Ś. 1. 19</ls>; <ls>Mk. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 4</ls>; <ls>Bh. 1. 57</ls>. .²3 A knot tied in the end of a garment for keeping money; hence, purse, money, property; कुसीदाद् दारिद्र्यं परकरगतग्नन्थिशमनात् <ls>Pt. 1. 11</ls>. .²4 The joint or knot of a reed, cane <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Mv. 3. 32</ls>. .²5 A joint of the body. .²6 Crookedness, distortion, falsehood, perversion of truth. .²7 Swelling and hardening of the vessels of the body. .²8 A difficult portion; ग्रन्थग्रन्थिं तदा चक्रे मुनिर्गूढं कुतूहलात् <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 80</ls>. .²9 A bell, gong; गृहीत्वा ग्रन्थिमुसलं मूढो भिक्षुरवादयत् <ls>Ks. 65. 135</ls>.
